results.title: IHSG Strengthens After BI Holds Rate, Analysts Recommend BNGA, BRMS, SRTG, and INDY
results.body: The Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) rose after Bank Indonesia kept its benchmark BI‑Rate at 5.75%, and analysts highlighted four stocks. IHSG closed at 6,374.91, up 97.87 points (1.56%), while foreign investors posted a net sell of about Rp408 billion on the day and roughly Rp102.9 trillion year‑to‑date. Analysts see resistance near 6,463 and support around 6,000‑6,035, with a potential target around 6,586 if volume confirms a breakout. The recommended issuers are PT Bank CIMB Niaga Tbk (BNGA), PT Bumi Resources Minerals Tbk (BRMS), PT Saratoga Investama Sedaya Tbk (SRTG) and PT Indika Energy Tbk (INDY), chosen for stable domestic rates, gold‑price exposure, strategic‑asset exposure and commodity‑sector sentiment respectively.

results.title: ASII shares slip below IDR5,000 as President Commissioner Prijono Sugiarto and President Director Rudy increase holdings
results.body: President Commissioner Prijono Sugiarto and President Director Rudy of ASII increased their shareholdings as the stock fell below the IDR5,000 level. Prijono bought 8,700 shares at IDR4,850 each on 21 September 2026, spending roughly IDR42.2 million, while Rudy acquired about 4.4 million shares in two transactions on 21‑22 September 2026 at IDR4,820 and IDR4,790, investing approximately IDR21.1 billion. The combined purchases lifted their collective ownership from 0,003 % to 0,0138 % and ASII closed down 0.63 % on 23 September, marking a 30.15 % decline year‑to‑date with the price remaining under IDR5,000 after briefly touching IDR5,050 on 3 September. The buying occurs amid an IDR8 trillion share buyback program that began in July 2026 and runs through July 2027, which has yet to lift the share price.

results.title: Foreign Net Sell Surpasses Rp 100 Trillion, Keeping PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk (BBRI), PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI) and PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (TLKM) Under Pressure
results.body: Foreign investors' net selling in the regular market reached Rp 102.9 trillion year‑to‑date, topping the Rp 100 trillion threshold and pressuring key stocks. On Wednesday, total foreign net sell across the market was Rp 460.7 billion, with the largest outflows in PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk (BBRI) at Rp 187.6 billion, PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI) at Rp 128.7 billion and PT Telkom Indonesia Tbk (TLKM) at Rp 124.6 billion. Conversely, PT Merdeka Copper Gold Tbk (MDKA) attracted a net foreign buy of Rp 106.7 billion and PT Timah Tbk (TINS) a net buy of Rp 53.7 billion, while the Indonesia Stock Exchange Composite Index (IHSG) closed up 97.8 points (1.5%) at 6,374.9 with total transaction value of Rp 12.8 trillion. Market commentator Hendra Wardana said the modest index gain reflected a positive reaction to Bank Indonesia’s decision to keep the BI Rate at 5.75% despite the continued foreign outflows.

results.title: Stock Market Outlook After Bank Indonesia Holds Benchmark Rate at 5.75%
results.body: Bank Indonesia kept the benchmark BI Rate at 5.75% in its 22‑23 September 2026 meeting, a decision analysts view as neutral to slightly positive for equities. The analysts note that the move was largely priced in, but external pressures from the U.S. Federal Reserve’s 3.75‑4.00% policy and the risk of a 25‑basis‑point BI hike to 6.00% by year‑end keep the market volatile. They project the Jakarta Composite Index (IHSG) to trade between 6,186 and 6,500 in the short term and cite target prices of Rp 3,430 for BBRI, Rp 4,500 for BMRI, Rp 6,800 for BBCA, Rp 212‑Rp 268 for BUMI, Rp 1,400‑Rp 1,900 for ENRG, and Rp 2,060‑Rp 2,280 for TPIA. The outlook remains sideways to negative in the near term unless the Fed pauses rate hikes and the rupiah stabilizes.

results.title: Morgan Stanley And Co International Plc purchases 400 million PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) shares for Rp10.8 billion, raising its stake to 7.0299%
results.body: Morgan Stanley And Co International Plc bought 400 million shares of PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) at Rp27 per share, a transaction valued at Rp10.8 billion. The purchase increased Morgan Stanley’s holding to 80.9 billion shares, representing 7,0299% of GOTO’s outstanding shares, up from 6,9951% previously. PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) will hold an extraordinary shareholders’ meeting on 14 October 2026 to consider the withdrawal of 32.18 billion Series A treasury shares and the resignation of Vice President Director Catherine Hindra Sutjahyo. These actions reflect ongoing adjustments to GOTO’s capital structure and governance.

results.title: Big Bank Stocks Rise Cohesively After BI-Rate Held at 5.75%
results.body: Following Bank Indonesia's decision to keep the BI-Rate at 5.75%, the shares of Indonesia's four big banks moved higher on 23 September 2026. PT Bank Central Asia Tbk (BBCA) led the rally, up 1.61% to Rp 6,300, while PT Bank Mandiri Tbk (BMRI) rose 0.72% to Rp 4,190, PT Bank Negara Indonesia Tbk (BBNI) gained 0.56% to Rp 3,590, and PT Bank Rakyat Indonesia Tbk (BBRI) increased 0.31% to Rp 3,190. Analysts from Kiwoom Sekuritas and Mirae Asset Sekuritas said the rate hold offers short‑term neutral‑positive sentiment but noted that cost‑of‑fund pressures, net interest margin dynamics, and external factors such as rupiah stability and US Treasury yields could limit further upside. Target prices were set at Rp 8,075 (BBCA), Rp 5,400 (BMRI) and Rp 4,000 (BBRI) by Kiwoom, and at Rp 7,900 (BBCA), Rp 4,720 (BMRI) and Rp 4,020 (BBNI) by Mirae Asset, while net foreign selling from 14‑18 September amounted to roughly Rp 798 billion for BBCA and Rp 443.2 billion for BMRI.

results.title: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) Tightens Investment in Non-Core Businesses
results.body: During Astra Media Day 2026 on 23 September, PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) said it will tighten its investment strategy for businesses outside its three core segments—automotive, financial services, and mining-solution & heavy-equipment operations. The company will evaluate its wider-business portfolio based on growth prospects, capital needs and contribution to the Astra ecosystem, continuing to invest in strategically important units, seeking partners for some, and re-assessing others. Wider-business segments contributed about 10% of the group’s consolidated profit, with net profit before non-recurring items of Rp1.6 trillion in the first half of 2026, a 31% increase year-on-year, while the core segments account for roughly 90% of profit. This tighter capital-allocation discipline aligns with Astra’s new corporate roadmap that emphasizes focus, clear strategy, disciplined capital deployment and transformation commitments.

results.title: PT Alamtri Minerals Indonesia Tbk (ADMR) posts 39.3% revenue growth in H1 2026 as its share price remains constrained
results.body: PT Alamtri Minerals Indonesia Tbk (ADMR) delivered a 39.3% year‑on‑year revenue increase to US$584 million in the first half of 2026, driven by a 9% rise in metallurgical coal sales and a gross margin expansion to 47.6%, while net profit rose 24% to US$174.2 million. The shares of PT Alamtri Minerals Indonesia Tbk (ADMR) were largely flat YTD, trading at Rp 1,560 after a 2.63% gain on 23 September. Through PT Kalimantan Aluminium Industry, ADMR plans to generate aluminium revenue in the second half of 2026, with the smelter ramping up toward a 500,000‑ton capacity by year‑end. Analysts view the aluminium expansion as a potential catalyst but warn of short‑term operational risks from low Barito River water and commodity price volatility.

results.title: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) plans major investment in its three core businesses, a Rp8 trillion share buyback and a stake increase in PT Astra Otoparts Tbk (AUTO) via a Rp858 billion VTO, and sets a target price of Rp7,000‑Rp7,300.
results.body: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) is allocating capital to its three core businesses—automotive, financial services and mining‑solutions & heavy‑equipment—which generate about 90% of group profit, and will raise its stake in PT Astra Otoparts Tbk (AUTO) through a voluntary tender offer at Rp3,600 per share costing up to Rp858 billion. The company also announced a share‑buyback of up to Rp8 trillion, reported H1‑2026 net profit of Rp12.5 trillion (‑19%) with segment growth of +9% automotive, +6% financial services and –46% mining‑equipment, and analysts set a target price of Rp7,000‑Rp7,300 per share, assuming continued automotive recovery and normalization of mining operations.

results.title: Morgan Stanley and Co International PLC boosts stake in PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) ahead of BEI's Rp1 minimum price rule
results.body: Morgan Stanley and Co International PLC increased its ownership of PT GoTo Gojek Tokopedia Tbk (GOTO) shares ahead of the upcoming minimum‑price change. On 18 September 2026, the investor bought 400 million ordinary shares at Rp27 per share, raising its holding from 80,539,349,984 to 80,939,349,984 shares. The purchase lifted its voting rights from 6,9951 % to 7,0299 %, a 0,0348‑percentage‑point increase. The transaction occurs as Bursa Efek Indonesia will lower the minimum trading price from Rp50 to Rp1 per share effective 28 September 2026, a rule that could affect GOTO’s share price dynamics.

results.title: PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR) raises coal RKAB to 12.4 million tons and continues to boost mineral mining business
results.body: PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR) revised its coal work‑and‑budget plan to 12.4 million tons for August 2026, up from about 7.4 million tons, while Jan‑Aug 2026 coal sales fell 19.4% YoY to 8.37 million tons and gold and nickel sales dropped 73.9% to 42,000 ounces and 1.05 million wet metric tons respectively. JP Morgan Sekuritas, the equity research firm that issued an overweight rating, projects $330 million excess free cash flow in 2027, maintains a Rp 2 trillion quarterly buyback and a Rp 30,200 target price for June 2027, as the stock traded at Rp 24,400 on 23 Sept.

results.title: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) outlines 2027 focus on three core businesses and plans to increase its stake in PT Astra Otoparts Tbk (AUTO)
results.body: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) is preparing its 2027 business strategy, focusing on automotive, financial services, and mining & heavy‑equipment solutions. The three segments contribute about 90 % of the company’s profit and will be prioritized for capital spending and investments. As part of the plan, PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) intends to raise its ownership in PT Astra Otoparts Tbk (AUTO) through a voluntary tender offer at Rp 3,600 per share, which could require roughly Rp 858 billion if the target shares are acquired. The company says any investments outside the three core businesses will be limited and will only be pursued if they meet its investment criteria.

results.title: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) realizes Rp17 trillion capex in H1 2026.
results.body: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) has realized about Rp17 trillion in capital expenditure (capex) for the first half of 2026, representing roughly 47.2% of its annual capex budget of Rp36 trillion. The realized capex is being used to fund PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR)’s acquisition of the gold mine PT Arafura Surya Alam. With the Rp17 trillion spend, ASII still has approximately Rp19 trillion of capex remaining for the rest of 2026, and the group’s total capex for the year is projected at Rp35.6 trillion. The three core business segments continue to contribute about 89% of Astra’s net profit and revenue, underscoring the focus of the capex allocation. On the day of the announcement, ASII shares fell 0.63% to Rp4,750, marking a 2.46% decline over five days and a 30.15% drop since the start of 2026.

results.title: PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR) receives approval to raise coal RKAB to 12.4 million tons
results.body: PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR) announced that the government approved an increase in its coal work plan and budget (RKAB) to 12.4 million tons, still below its 15‑million‑ton production capacity. The new RKAB level exceeds the 7.4‑million‑ton plan approved for the first half of 2026. UNTR reported that coal sales fell 22 % to 6,723 tons and heavy‑equipment sales dropped 21 % to 2,689 units in the January‑August 2026 period, with big‑machine sales declining to 436 units from 860 units a year earlier. The company attributed the slowdown to the limited RKAB and El Nino‑related production constraints in Central Kalimantan, projecting that coal sales will only return to optimal levels in November‑December.

results.title: Prijono Sugiarto Buy Shares of Astra International
results.body: On 21 September 2026, Astra International insider Prijono Sugiarto bought 8,700 shares at IDR 4,850 per share, a transaction worth IDR 42,195,000, increasing his stake to 5,595,800 shares (0.014% of the company) and classified as an investment. The purchase adds to a recent wave of insider buying at Astra International, where insiders have collectively acquired more than 6 million shares in the past six months.

results.title: Rudy Buy Shares of Astra International
results.body: Insider Rudy purchased a total of 4,400,000 Astra International shares over two days at an average price of IDR 4,804 per share, spending IDR 21,142,000,000. The transaction raised his holding from 1,200,000 to 5,600,000 shares, lifting his ownership from 0.003% to 0.014% and is reported as an investment. The purchase follows a series of insider accumulations in recent months, including multiple buys by senior executives such as Prijono Sugiarto and Djap Tet Fa, indicating continued insider confidence in the stock.

results.title: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) announces focus on three core profit-generating segments
results.body: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) said it will concentrate development on three core businesses—automotive, financial services, and mining solutions & heavy equipment. These segments currently contribute 40%, 31% and 18% of revenue respectively, with other businesses accounting for 11%. Astra plans to increase its stake in AUTO through a voluntary tender offer at Rp3,600 per share, a transaction that could cost about Rp858 billion, and it approved a share-buyback program of up to Rp8 trillion for the next 12 months; United Tractors (UT) also announced a share-buyback of up to Rp2 trillion for three months. In the latest period, the automotive unit posted net profit of Rp5.9 trillion (+9% YoY), financial services Rp4.6 trillion (+6% YoY), while mining solutions & heavy equipment recorded Rp2.7 trillion, down 46% YoY.

results.title: PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR) earmarks Rp7.1 trillion for share buyback through June 2026
results.body: PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR), a subsidiary of Astra International, has earmarked a total of Rp7.1 trillion for share repurchases from July 2022 through 30 June 2026. The company completed a buyback of 35.5 million shares between 1 April and 30 June 2026 and will be able to repurchase up to Rp2 trillion of shares between 1 July and 30 September 2026. To date, UNTR has bought back 239 million shares worth Rp7.1 trillion, while its stock has fallen 17.46% year‑to‑date and trades in a range of Rp20,125 to Rp32,825 per share. The buyback aims to reinforce investor confidence and stabilize the share price amid market volatility.

results.title: RKAB increases to 12.4 million tons, PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR) aims to boost coal production in the second half of 2026
results.body: PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR) raised its coal RKAB quota from about 7.4 million tons to 12.4 million tons in August 2026, giving the company a chance to boost output in the second half of the year. UNTR plans to schedule production and sales for November–December 2026 while holding some inventory, despite weather challenges from El Nino in Central Kalimantan. Coal sales through PT Tuah Turangga Agung reached 8.37 million tons in Jan–Aug 2026, a 19.44 % YoY decline from 10.39 million tons, while gold sales from Agincourt Resources and Sumbawa Jutaraya fell 73.91 % YoY to 42 000 ounces and nickel ore sales via Stargate dropped to 1.05 million wet metric tons (711 000 limonite, 348 000 saprolite) from 1.43 million tons in 2025. Coal production for UNTR’s customers via PT Pamapersada Nusantara also slipped 2.91 % YoY to 93.4 million tons.

results.title: Morgan Stanley And Co International Plc Buy Shares of GoTo Gojek Tokopedia
results.body: Institutional investor Morgan Stanley And Co International Plc purchased 400,000,000 shares of GoTo Gojek Tokopedia at IDR 27 per share, costing IDR 10,800,000,000, raising its holding to 80,939,349,984 shares (7.030% of the company) from 80,539,349,984 shares (6.995%). The buy adds to a series of purchases this year, including 3,138,522,500 shares at IDR 23 on Aug 26 and 9,221,177,326 shares at IDR 25 on Sep 7, indicating a continued accumulation that has lifted the institution’s stake from under 5% to just over 7%.

results.title: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) reports first‑half 2026 capex of Rp 17 trillion, driven by subsidiary PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR).
results.body: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) disclosed that it has realized approximately Rp 17 trillion of capital expenditure in the first half of 2026, out of a total planned capex of Rp 35‑36 trillion for the year. The majority of the spending was incurred by its subsidiary PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR), primarily for the acquisition of the Arafura Surya Alam gold mine and for routine purchases of heavy equipment for its mining contractor business. Astra indicated that the remaining capex budget will be allocated in a disciplined manner to support productivity and profit growth through 2027. The company said it will continue periodic evaluations to ensure the capex contributes optimally to earnings growth.

results.title: RKAB Dampens Heavy Equipment Sales, PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR) Impacted
results.body: RKAB, the mining work-plan and budget policy, is curbing heavy equipment purchases, hitting PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR) and its subsidiary PT Pamapersada Nusantara (PAMA). UNTR's Komatsu equipment sales fell 21% to 2,689 units (big-machine sales down 49% to 436 units) in the first eight months of 2026, while PAMA’s overburden removal and coal production activity slipped 8%, though UNTR’s parts and service revenue rose 1% to about Rp5.5 trillion, offsetting some pressure.

results.title: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) reports capex absorption of Rp17 trillion in the first half of 2026
results.body: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) said it has realized about Rp17 trillion of its planned Rp36 trillion capital expenditure for 2026 by the end of the first semester. The realized capex includes the acquisition of the gold mine PT Arafura Surya Alam, which was carried out by PT United Tractors Tbk. The remaining budget is split into Rp15 trillion for maintenance capex and Rp21 trillion for strategic investments, as outlined by President Director Rudi. PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) indicated that future capex allocations will be evaluated to ensure they support business productivity and growth.

results.title: PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR) reports coal production and heavy‑equipment sales decline as RKAB approval is cut by 50%
results.body: UNTR’s coal production capacity of 15 million tons was limited to 7.4 million tons under the government‑approved RKAB, resulting in a 22 % year‑on‑year drop in coal sales to 6,723 tons for the January‑August 2026 period. The same RKAB reduction also cut Komatsu heavy‑equipment sales by 21 % to 2,689 units, with big‑machine sales falling from 860 to 436 units, while the company expects RKAB to rise to 12.4 million tons in August 2026 and anticipates production recovery in November‑December 2026 despite El Nino‑related challenges.

results.title: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) reaffirms focus on three core businesses through 2027
results.body: On 23 September 2026, PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) reaffirmed its focus on three core businesses—automotive, financial services, and mining solutions & heavy equipment—through 2027. These three segments together generate roughly 90% of the group's profit. To deepen its automotive component capabilities, the company plans to increase its stake in PT Astra Otoparts Tbk (AUTO) via a Voluntary Tender Offer at Rp 3,600 per share, requiring about Rp 858 billion if all targeted shares are acquired. Capital spending and investments will be prioritized for the three core businesses, while the firm remains open to selective opportunities outside this focus, though no significant additional investments are expected at this time.

results.title: UNTR's RKAB approval delayed, new coal production allocation set at 12.4 million tons
results.body: PT Unit d Tractors Tbk (UNTR) said its approved coal production capacity under the RKAB was reduced to 7.4 million tons, about half of the original 15 million‑ton target, due to a delayed RKAB approval process. The company also reported a 22 percent drop in coal sales in the first eight months of 2026, but noted that an August allocation increased its RKAB capacity to 12.4 million tons.

results.title: PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR) feels impact of RKAB policy on coal operations and revenue
results.body: PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR) said the Rencana Kerja dan Anggaran Biaya (RKAB) policy continues to pressure its mining operations through August 2026. Coal production at its subsidiary Pamapersada Nusantara (PAMA) fell 3% year‑on‑year to 96.2 million tons, overburden removal dropped 8% to 670.2 million bcm and the stripping ratio slipped to 7.2 from 7.6. Revenue for the six‑month period ended 30 June 2026 declined 15% to IDR 5.8 trillion, while PAMA’s revenue still grew and a higher nickel price and a stronger US dollar partially offset the volume weakness. UNTR, which has a coal production capacity of 15 million tons, increased its approved RKAB to 12.4 million tons in August and is cutting capex and prioritising spending to navigate the dry season in Central Kalimantan.

results.title: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) reports Rp17 trillion capex in H1 2026, targeting Rp36 trillion total for the year.
results.body: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) has realized Rp17 trillion of capital expenditure in the first half of 2026, which is almost half of its planned Rp36 trillion capex for the year. The bulk of the spending was driven by its mining business, primarily through its subsidiary PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR), covering gold and other mineral operations. The remainder of the capex consists of routine investments such as heavy‑equipment purchases for mining contractors. Astra expects to allocate the remaining roughly Rp19 trillion in the second half of 2026 in a more disciplined manner to support future growth.

results.title: PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR) reports coal production and heavy equipment sales fall as RKAB approvals lag
results.body: PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR) said its coal production and heavy equipment sales have declined because the government has not fully approved its Rencana Kerja dan Anggaran Biaya (RKAB). The company has a total coal production capacity of 15 million tons but only 7.4 million tons of RKAB were approved in the first half of 2026, about 50% of capacity, later rising to 12.4 million tons in August. Coal sales from January to August 2026 fell 22% to 6,723 tons, while heavy equipment sales dropped 21% to 2,689 units, with big‑machine sales halving to 436 units from 860 a year earlier. The downturn is also linked to El Nino‑induced dry conditions in Central Kalimantan, and the company expects coal sales to improve in the November‑December quarter.

results.title: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) reports first‑half 2026 capex realization of Rp 17 trillion, 47.2% of annual target
results.body: PT Astra International Tbk (ASII) said that in the first half of 2026 it has realized about Rp 17 trillion of its planned Rp 36 trillion capex, representing roughly 47.2% of the yearly target. The bulk of the realized capex was used for the acquisition of the gold mine PT Arafura Surya Alam by PT United Tractors Tbk (UNTR). The remaining portion funded routine capital spending, mainly the purchase of heavy equipment to support United Tractors’ mining contractor operations. The company indicated that the balance of the capex budget will be allocated more selectively and disciplined to sustain future business growth, with ongoing evaluation.
